reponse: The design-partner beta opens Wednesday, Dec 9 — five customers: Orbitly, Zest Grocers, and three accounts from the October trial cohort [3][4]. That's phase 1 (chart builder + saved views), already feature-complete behind the dash_v2 flag [3]. Other customers won't get access before general availability, which is targeted for late January, with a waitlist opening in January [3][4].
